**Comparability note:** Both companies use a calendar fiscal year ending December 31, so the FY2023→FY2024 periods align. The line items differ slightly in label — Meta reports "revenue" [DOC-1] while Amazon reports "net sales" [DOC-1] — but both represent the consolidated top line, so the growth-rate comparison is appropriate. Neither figure is adjusted for divestitures, acquisitions, or segment redefinitions.

**Meta Platforms**
- FY2023 revenue $134,902M; FY2024 revenue $164,501M [DOC-1]
- Growth = (164,501 − 134,902) / 134,902 = 29,599 / 134,902 = **+21.94%**

**Amazon.com**
- FY2023 net sales $574,785M; FY2024 net sales $637,959M [DOC-1]
- Growth = (637,959 − 574,785) / 574,785 = 63,174 / 574,785 = **+10.99%**

**Difference:** 21.94% − 10.99% ≈ **10.95 percentage points**, with Meta growing faster. Note that Meta's faster rate is off a revenue base roughly one-quarter the size of Amazon's; in absolute dollars Amazon added more revenue ($63.2B vs. $29.6B) [DOC-1].

ANSWER: Meta grew faster — 21.94% vs. Amazon's 10.99%, a gap of approximately 10.9–11.0 percentage points (≈10.95 pp)
